titulo: Quiz — From the airport to the hotel
subtitulo: Hear the Mexican sound model inside a useful arrival exchange
introPt: You have landed in Mexico. Listen to one short taxi exchange and one hotel exchange. Catch the destination, the confirmation and the reservation — not every sound.
cenario: An authorised airport taxi drops the traveller at a hotel in the Historic Centre. At reception, the traveller opens the reservation.

dialogo.pt: Good afternoon. Where are you going?

dialogo.es: Al hotel del Centro Histórico, por favor.
dialogo.pinyin: ahl oh-TEL del SEN-troh ees-TOH-ree-koh, por fah-BOR
dialogo.pt: To the hotel in the Historic Centre, please.

dialogo.pinyin: BWEH-nahs TAR-dehs. en keh leh ah-YOO-doh
dialogo.pt: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

perguntas.pergunta: Where does the traveller ask the driver to go?
opcoes: A hotel in the Historic Centre
perguntas.explica: The destination is 'el hotel del Centro Histórico'. The stress lands at the end of hotel: ho-TEL.

opcoes: Whether to use the main entrance
perguntas.explica: '¿Por la entrada principal?' checks the entrance before the driver commits to the drop-off point.

perguntas.pergunta: Which pronunciation belongs to the Mexican model in this course?
perguntas.explica: Mexican Spanish is seseante: soft C and Z use /s/, not the central-Spain /θ/.

perguntas.pergunta: At reception, what opens the booking?
perguntas.explica: 'Tengo una reservación' states that the booking already exists; the clerk then asks for the name.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the purpose of the hand movements in B01?
opcoes: To expose swallowed syllables, sliding vowels and misplaced stress
To imitate one regional Mexican accent
perguntas.explica: The gestures betray the specific English-speaking errors that make familiar words hard to recognise. Sounding foreign is allowed.
